analytics-admin.mcp__analytics-admin__ga_get_data_retent: Get the property's event data retention settings.
analytics-admin.mcp__analytics-admin__ga_get_data_stream: Get full details for one data stream (incl. webStreamData.measurementId).
analytics-admin.mcp__analytics-admin__ga_get_property: Get the property resource (display name, time zone, currency, industry, etc.).

analytics-admin.mcp__analytics-admin__ga_update_data_ret: Update event data retention. Requires Editor/Administrator.
analytics-admin.mcp__analytics-admin__ga_update_property: Update basic property settings. Requires Editor/Administrator. Only pass the fields to change.
analytics-admin.mcp__analytics-admin__ga_update_user_acc: Change the roles on an existing access binding. Requires Administrator. Pass the full desired role set (it replaces the existing roles).
analytics-admin.mcp__analytics-admin__ga_update_web_data: Update a web data stream's display name and/or default URI. Requires Editor/Administrator. Only pass the fields to change.

The path must begin with /d2l/api/ and may contain a {v} placeholder, which is replaced with the version this server negotiated for that product. Quiz and survey attempt, question and answer paths are refused, as are paths that would read another person's submitted work. Redirects
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_api_request: Send one request to a Brightspace API path with the current session. GET behaves like bs_api_get. Any other method writes to Brightspace: it requires writes to be enabled and confirm=true, it sends the request exactly once, it is never retried, and without confirm=true it returns a preview of the method, path and body that would be sent. Every method is refused on a quiz or survey path, and every
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_assignment_feedback: Return the published feedback on one assignment folder for the current account or for one of its groups: score, graded symbol, feedback text, rubric assessments, feedback files and feedback links.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_auth_status: Report whether this server currently has a usable Brightspace session, which sign-in state it is in, and which host it is connected to. Reads no course data.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_browser_back: Go back one entry in the current page's history.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_browser_click: Click one element on the current page, addressed by a reference from the most recent snapshot or by its role and accessible name. Clicking can change what Brightspace stores. A click that navigates into a quiz-taking page is undone and refused.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_browser_download: Click one element that starts a download and save the resulting file into this server's download directory, returning the file name and size. The file name is chosen by this server, not by the page.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_browser_evaluate: Run a JavaScript expression in the current page and return its result. This tool is disabled unless it has been explicitly enabled in this server's configuration, is always refused on an identity provider's page and on a quiz page, and its result is redacted before it is returned.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_browser_fill: Replace the whole value of one form field on the current page. It refuses to fill a field on a page that contains a password field, and refuses on an identity provider's page.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_browser_hover: Hover the pointer over one element on the current page, which some menus need before their items appear.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_browser_navigate: Open a URL on the configured Brightspace host in this server's browser page. Addresses on other hosts are refused, and a quiz-taking page is refused.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_browser_press: Press one key on the current page or on one element of it. It refuses on a page that contains a password field and on an identity provider's page.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_browser_screenshot: Save a screenshot of the current page to this server's artifact directory and return its file name and size. Screenshots of an identity provider's page are refused.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_browser_select: Select one or more options in a dropdown on the current page.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_browser_snapshot: Return an accessibility snapshot of the current page: the roles, names, text and state of its elements, with a reference marker on each interactive element that the other browser tools accept. References become stale as soon as the page navigates.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_browser_tabs: List the browser tabs this server has open, or make one of them current, or close one.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_browser_type: Type text into one element on the current page, optionally pressing Enter afterwards. It refuses to type into a page that contains a password field, and refuses on an identity provider's page.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_browser_upload: Attach one or more local files to a file input on the current page. Only files under the configured upload roots may be attached. Attaching a file can already cause Brightspace to act on it, before any submit button is pressed, so it also requires writes to be enabled.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_browser_wait_for: Wait until text appears on the current page or the page reaches a load state, up to a bounded timeout.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_calendar_events: List the calendar events visible to the current account in a time window, for one or more courses, with title, description, start and end, all-day flag, recurrence, event type where the host publishes it, and the associated activity.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_classlist: List the people enrolled in one course as Brightspace exposes them to the current account, with display name, role name and whatever contact fields the host and the privacy settings allow. Fields the host suppresses come back empty; that is not an error. Contact fields for other people are withheld unless this server is configured to include them. Brightspace may refuse this request here.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_content_progress: Return the current account's recorded progress for one course's content: visit counts, time spent, last visited and completion state, per topic. This route is published by Brightspace under an explicitly unstable contract and may change or be unavailable.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_content_toc: Return one course's content table of contents: modules and topics with their identifiers, titles, type identifier, activity type, completion type and whether each is hidden, locked or broken. By default it returns the ordinary learner-visible table of contents. The table of contents does not publish a topic's description or its content-object type; bs_content_topic returns those for one topic.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_content_topic: Return one content topic's metadata: its title, type, whether it is a file, a link or an external activity, its URL, description, dates and its parent module.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_course_overview: Return one course's identifier, name, code, dates, description and semester or department when Brightspace exposes them, together with the current account's access state for it. Falls back to the enrollment record when the course-offering route is not permitted for this account.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_create_calendar_eve: Create one calendar event in a course's calendar as the current account. Without confirm=true it returns exactly what would be sent and creates nothing. Brightspace does not document a private personal calendar for this route: the event is created in the named course's calendar context and Brightspace decides who can see it. Brightspace may refuse this request here.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_debug_state: Report this server's own state: whether a Brightspace session is available, which host it is connected to, which API versions it negotiated for each Brightspace product, and whether writes and the evaluate tool are enabled. It returns no file paths, no cookies and no page details.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_dismiss_announcemen: Dismiss one announcement for the current account so Brightspace stops showing it. This writes to Brightspace and is not the same as marking something read. Without confirm=true it previews the announcement that would be dismissed.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_download_assignment: Download the attachments of one assignment folder, of one of the current account's own submissions, or of the published feedback on it, into this server's download directory. With no file identifier it downloads every attachment of the selected kind.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_download_certificat: Download one of the current account's issued certificates as a PDF into this server's download directory.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_download_course_con: Download every file topic in one course into a folder under this server's download directory and write a manifest listing each topic, its saved file, its size, and every item that was skipped with the reason. Without confirm=true it returns the manifest that would be produced and downloads nothing. This writes files to this machine only; it changes nothing in Brightspace.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_download_topic: Download one file topic to this server's download directory and return the saved file name, size and content type. Topics that are links, external activities or HTML pages are reported as such and are not downloaded.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_duo_select_method: Select one of the two-factor methods currently offered in the browser, by its exact label as returned by bs_login or bs_login_wait. It is refused unless a method chooser is open. Selecting a push method sends exactly one push. Selecting a text-message or phone method causes that message or call to be sent, once.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_duo_submit_passcode: Submit one two-factor passcode to the passcode prompt currently open in the browser. It is refused unless that prompt is open. Supply a passcode read from the authenticator by the person at the keyboard; when a HOTP seed is configured on this server and no passcode is given, one is generated from it. The value is used once, replaced by a placeholder in every log and trace, and not stored. It is su
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_final_grade: Return the current account's calculated final grade for one course, or for every actively enrolled course at once. This is the value Brightspace calculates and releases in the course; it is not an institutional transcript grade.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_get_announcement: Return one announcement in full, optionally downloading its attachments into this server's download directory.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_get_assignment: Return one assignment folder in full, including its instructions, its attachments, its due date, its availability window and its resubmission rule.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_get_quiz: Return one quiz's metadata: its dates, attempts allowed, time limit and linked grade item. This returns metadata only. It does not open, start, read questions from, answer or submit a quiz.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_list_announcements: List one course's announcements with title, body, attachments, publication window and whether each is pinned or global.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_list_assignments: List one course's assignment folders with identifier, name, due date, availability window, submission type, group type, resubmission rule and linked grade item. Availability dates are reported separately from the due date and are not deadlines.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_list_awards: List the awards and certificates issued to the current account, and optionally those available to earn, with their issue and expiry dates and criteria.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_list_checklists: List one course's checklists with their categories and items, including each item's due date. Brightspace publishes checklist definitions through this route; it does not publish a per-account checked state, so none is returned.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_list_courses: List course offerings the current account is enrolled in. By default it returns active, accessible offerings whose access window includes today; undated offerings are included and flagged. Set include_groups=true to also include section and project groups, or supply org_unit_type_ids to override the org-unit types. Use term to select current, past, future or all offerings. Rows are compact unless
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_list_external_links: List one course's content entries that launch something outside Brightspace: link topics, legacy and Advantage external tool activities, and SCORM packages, with the launch URL Brightspace publishes for each. It reports the launch target; it does not open it.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_list_forums: List one course's discussion forums with name, description and whether each is hidden or locked.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_list_posts: List the posts in one discussion topic, optionally only the thread starters or only one thread's replies, with author, subject, message, posting date, reply relationships, read state and attachment count.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_list_quizzes: List one course's quizzes as metadata only: name, active state, start, end and due dates, attempts allowed, time limit and linked grade item. This returns metadata only. It does not open, start, read questions from, answer or submit a quiz.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_list_surveys: List one course's surveys as metadata only: name, active state, anonymity, dates and how many responses are allowed. It does not open or answer a survey.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_list_topics: List one discussion forum's topics with name, description, due date where the host publishes it, and the rules that apply: locked, hidden, group-restricted, must-post-to-participate, moderated.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_login: Start sign-in to the configured Brightspace host in this server's own browser profile. When no credentials are configured this opens a visible browser window for a person to sign in by hand. When a NetID and a password source are configured it submits them once. Returns as soon as the flow reaches the two-factor step, reporting whether a push was sent, whether a verification code is shown in the b
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_login_wait: Wait for a sign-in that bs_login started to finish. Polls the browser until a Brightspace session exists, or the two-factor step is denied, times out, or needs a different action. It never approves a factor and never sends a push, a text message or a phone call. It does answer the 'stay signed in' and 'remember this device' prompts affirmatively for this server's own private browser profile, which
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_logout: End the Brightspace session held in this server's browser profile and clear that host's cookies. It does not sign out of the identity provider, and the next sign-in may therefore complete without a second factor. Without confirm=true it reports what it would clear and clears nothing.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_mark_post_read: Set the read state of one discussion post for the current account. This writes to Brightspace.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_mark_topic_complete: Mark one content topic complete for the current account, or clear its completion. This writes to Brightspace. Brightspace may refuse this request here, in which case the tool reports that rather than retrying.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_my_grades: Return the current account's grade values for one course: the displayed grade, points, weight, comments and release date for each graded item. A value of zero is reported as zero and an unassessed item is reported as unassessed; the two are never merged. Grade item definitions are included only when asked for and only when Brightspace permits reading them for this account.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_my_groups: List the group categories in one course and, within each, the groups the current account belongs to. With all_groups=true it lists every group in each category instead, which Brightspace may refuse here.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_my_sections: List the sections of one course that the current account is enrolled in.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_my_submissions: List the current account's submissions to one assignment folder, with submission dates, submitted files, submission comments, the recorded status and any published feedback.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_notifications: List the recent notifications Brightspace holds for the current account. It reads the alerts route first and falls back to the account's aggregate feed when the host does not publish alerts to this account; the entry says which source produced it. With no time bounds the feed covers roughly the preceding day, so an empty result does not mean nothing happened.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_overdue_items: List the items Brightspace records as overdue for the current account, with the course, the item name and its due date.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_pin_course: Pin or unpin one course in the current account's Brightspace course list. This changes what Brightspace shows on the course list; it does not change enrollment. Without confirm=true it previews the change and writes nothing.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_post_discussion: Create a new discussion thread in one topic as the current account. Without confirm=true it returns a preview of the topic it would post to, the rules that apply to it, and the exact subject and message that would be sent; nothing is posted. Brightspace does not support creating posts in group-type topics through this route, and the tool reports that instead of trying.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_quiz_attempts: Return the recorded attempts on one quiz for the current account: attempt number, score where it has been released, start and completion times, and whether the attempt is published. It returns attempt metadata only and reads no questions or answers. Brightspace gates these routes behind a grading permission and may refuse them for this account.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_reply_discussion: Reply to one discussion post as the current account. Without confirm=true it returns a preview of the post being replied to and the exact message that would be sent; nothing is posted.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_search_content: Find content topics and modules whose title contains a query string. The search is performed by this server over each course's retrieved table of contents; Brightspace is not asked to search, and the table of contents carries titles but not descriptions. With no course, it searches every course the current account can access, which requires one table-of-contents read per course.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_submit_assignment: Submit one or more local files to a Brightspace assignment folder as the current account. Without confirm=true it returns a preview: the folder name, its due date and whether the submission would be late, its resubmission rule, the current submission count and each file's name, size and type; nothing is sent. brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_trace_get: Return the redacted timeline of one tool run: its stages and their durations, how many requests, navigations and retries it made, which status codes it saw, and how it ended. It returns no URLs, no request bodies, no selectors and no file paths.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_trace_list: List this server's recent tool runs with the tool name, when it started, how long it took, whether it succeeded and its diagnosis. It returns a timeline summary only; the full detail is on this machine and is read with the server's own command-line viewer.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_unread_counts: Return Brightspace's own work counts for the current account per course: unread assignment feedback, unapproved discussions, unattempted quizzes, ungraded quizzes, unread assignment submissions and unread discussions. These are counts Brightspace computes for the current session; they are not a complete list of assignments or grades.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_user_profile: Return a Brightspace user profile. With no argument it returns the current account's own profile. With an identifier it returns another person's profile only if Brightspace permits it, and reports a refusal plainly when it does not. Contact fields for other people are withheld unless this server is configured to include them.
brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_whats_due: List what is scheduled or due for the current account across its active courses within a window, combining Brightspace's scheduled content items, its assignment folders and its quiz metadata. Each entry keeps the source it came from and its own identifiers. A due date and an availability window are reported separately and an availability window is never presented as a deadline. brightspace.mcp__brightspace__bs_whoami: Return the identifier, display name and username of the account the current Brightspace session belongs to.

coolify.mcp__coolify__coolify_url: Dashboard URL for a resource. Never write a Coolify URL by hand.
coolify.mcp__coolify__database: Manage database: create/update/move/delete. `update` is how you expose an existing database on a public port (`is_public` + `public_port`) or change limits/credentials. Credential fields must match the engine (postgres_* on postgresql, and so on); changing any *_user/*_password on update asks for confirmation, since every app holding the old value breaks.
coolify.mcp__coolify__deployment: Manage deployment: get/cancel/list_for_app/rollback_images. Logs excluded by default on all actions — for get use `lines` (paginated tail), for list_for_app use `include_logs: true` to include raw build-log blobs. rollback_images takes an application uuid (Coolify 4.3+); an empty list means Coolify could not inspect the server.
coolify.mcp__coolify__env_vars: Manage env vars for app, service, or database. Values are masked by default (returned as '***') to avoid leaking secrets to MCP clients; pass reveal=true on the list action when the caller explicitly needs the plaintext (e.g. 'what is FOO set to?'). On list, pass key to return only that variable — always combine reveal with key so only the requested value (not every secret on the resource) is expo
coolify.mcp__coolify__environments: Manage environments: list/get/create/delete/verify_app (get includes dragonfly/keydb/clickhouse DBs missing from API; when the project has exactly one environment, get may omit name; verify_app proves application_uuid is bound to environment `name` of project_uuid using only exact endpoints, a pre-mutation guard)
coolify.mcp__coolify__get_application: App details. Credentials (webhook secrets, basic-auth password, compose bodies, labels) are masked by default; pass reveal: true when you explicitly need them.
coolify.mcp__coolify__get_database: Database details. Credentials (passwords, connection URLs) are masked by default; pass reveal: true when you explicitly need them, e.g. to wire an app to the database.
coolify.mcp__coolify__get_infrastructure_overvie: Overview of all resources with counts
coolify.mcp__coolify__get_server: Server details. Sentinel and log-drain credentials are always masked.
coolify.mcp__coolify__get_service: Service details. Credentials (compose bodies with resolved passwords, webhook secrets) are masked by default; pass reveal: true when you explicitly need them.
coolify.mcp__coolify__list_destinations: List Docker network destinations (Coolify v4.2+). A server with more than one destination requires `destination_uuid` on application/database/service create; this is where to find it.
coolify.mcp__coolify__logs: Get container logs for an application, database, or service. A service is a multi-container stack, so resource='service' requires `container` — the sub-service name, which you can list with the `service` tool's `list_containers` action. Use `lines` to bound the output and `show_timestamps` when you need to correlate events across resources (not supported on service containers).
coolify.mcp__coolify__private_keys: Manage SSH keys: list/get/create/update/delete. Key material is never returned; identify keys by name, fingerprint and public key.
coolify.mcp__coolify__scheduled_tasks: Manage scheduled tasks for app or service: list/create/update/delete/list_executions/run_once. list_executions: the command's stdout comes back in the execution's message field. run_once: composite that creates a throwaway "* * * * *" task, polls list_executions every ~5s for the first terminal execution (or until wait_seconds elapses, default 90), deletes the task, and returns status+message. coolify.mcp__coolify__search_docs: Search the official Coolify docs index. Returns matching pages (title, url, one-line description) ranked by relevance — fetch the url for full detail.
coolify.mcp__coolify__service: Manage service: create/update/move/delete/list_containers/update_application/start_application/stop_application/restart_application. A service is a multi-container stack; `list_containers` returns the applications and databases inside it, whose names are what the `logs` tool needs as `container`. Use `update_application` to change a sub-application's FQDN (url) or other settings. Use `start_applic
coolify.mcp__coolify__storages: Manage persistent/file storages for app, database, or service: list/create/update/delete, plus volume backups (v4.2+): backup_set/backup_delete/backup_run. backup_set REPLACES the schedule — omitted fields revert to defaults and there is no read-back endpoint, so send it whole. backup_delete deletes the archives too.
coolify.mcp__coolify__system: System operations: health/list_resources/enable_api/disable_api. `list_resources` defaults to an essential projection (uuid/name/type/status) to keep token budgets sane on instances with many resources; pass `include_full: true` for the raw Coolify payload. coolify.mcp__coolify__tags: Manage tags on applications, databases and services. pension-filings.mcp__pension-filings__find_providers: Find service-provider firms by name, with how many plans pay them and those plans' total assets. role: optional filter on a known derived role (e.g. investment manager, investment advisor, custodian, administrator, actuary, broker, trustee, legal, accountant).

pension-filings.mcp__pension-filings__provider_clients: Every plan that pays a given provider (by name, matched loosely), largest first, with filters.
pension-filings.mcp__pension-filings__run_sql: Read-only escape hatch: run a single SELECT or WITH statement over the public/raw schemas for anything the other tools don't cover. pension-filings.mcp__pension-filings__search_funds: Search extracted pooled funds/managers (from PDF attachments) by name, manager, asset class, kind (separate_account, collective_trust, mutual_fund, partnership, hedge_fund, real_estate_fund, insurance_contract, master_trust, cash_sweep, other), or minimum value.
pension-filings.mcp__pension-filings__search_plans: Find plans with any combination of filters, all optional. text matches plan/sponsor name or an exact EIN. plan_type: defined_benefit, union (=multiemployer), single_employer, or omit for any. signal_flags: list of plan_signals boolean flags that must all be true (e.g. ["heavy_turnover_flag", "withdrawal_liability_present"]) -- see describe_data for the full list. sort_by: total_assets, participant
